articles.title: Asia’s 75-point gap: Moving consumers from retirement angst to action
articles.summary: Asians are worried about retirement but largely underprepared for it. The retirement industry can close the gap between customers’ awareness and action by rethinking traditional approaches to insurance.

articles.title: Investing in the energy transition: Time to look at whole-system value
articles.summary: In an expanding global energy system, the next phase of the transition will require not just more low-carbon capacity but also system-wide investment in flexibility and resilience.

articles.title: Europe on the move: A conversation with Boerse Stuttgart Group’s CEO
articles.summary: With 160 years of experience, Boerse Stuttgart Group is Europe's sixth-largest exchange group, helping position Europe for the future through digital, blockchain innovation, and financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Revolutionizing semiconductor fab operations with AI
articles.summary: AI has the potential to improve build processes and operations within semiconductor fabs. Early adopters could see significant cost improvement and productivity gains.

articles.title: AstraZeneca’s Bob Li on the MARS mission to eliminate cancer
articles.summary: Bob Li, AstraZeneca’s Senior Vice President, Global Head of Medical Affairs, Oncology, on why only 7 percent of cancer patients get access to clinical trials, and what decentralized trials, AI, and international collaboration could do to change that within a decade.
